newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico steelmaker Corey in U.S. partnership talks.
newsitem.headline: Mexico steelmaker Corey in U.S. partnership talks.

text.p: The steel unit of Grupo Corey is negotiating a partnership with a U.S. firm, company's deputy director general Rene Calderon Bujdud said on Thursday.
"Negotiations are at an advanced stage with a...U.S. firm to provide capital before the end of the year," Calderon told Reuters.
"We would be selling part of our company, Unidad Aceros... We're talking about 20 or 30 percent of the firm's equity, " he said.
The partnership would allow Corey to increase steel exports to South America, he said, giving few other details for the moment.
